title: Ellmis Zauberwelt Hartkaiser Ellmau
highlights: Magischer Natur-Erlebnispark auf 1555 Metern Seehoehe am Hartkaiser direkt gegenueber dem Wilden Kaiser
Grosser Zauberwald mit sprechenden Baeumen, Wichtelstationen und Schatzsuchen
Schnitzhuette, Kletterburg, Labyrinth und botanischer Bergpflanzen-Lehrpfad
Bequem erreichbar mit der modernen 10er-Gondelbahn Hartkaiserbahn ab Ellmau
kurzbeschreibung: Ellmis Zauberwelt on the Hartkaiser in Ellmau invites children at 1,555 metres into a magical enchanted forest adventure with mythical creatures.
beschreibung:
Following in the Footsteps of Ellmi the Magic Frog

High atop the 1,555-metre-high Hartkaiser in Ellmau, families will discover Ellmis Zauberwelt. Within a four-hectare spruce forest, children dive into the tale of the wizard apprentice Ellmi, who was transformed into a frog by goblins.

Exciting Puzzle Stations Against an Imperial Backdrop

Along winding woodland paths, young explorers solve tricky nature riddles, explore the carving hut, and discover hidden goblin nests. Meanwhile, parents can relax on the panoramic sun terrace of the Bergkaiser-Restaurant and take in the magnificent view of the Wilder Kaiser.
